## What system/approach is used

The frontend styling of this IRIS HIS monorepo is built on a layered, legacy-compatible approach:

1. **jQuery EasyUI (v1.3.5)** — the base UI framework providing panels, dialogs, datagrids, tabs, forms, and layout regions (`hisui-layout`, `hisui-panel`, `hisui-dialog`, `hisui-textbox`, etc.). Its theme files are referenced directly from `scripts_lib/jquery-easyui-1.3.5/themes/default/easyui.css` and `themes/icon.css`.
2. **HISUI** — an in-house extension/customization layer on top of EasyUI that adds domain-specific classes like `hisui-label`, `hisui-validatebox`, `hisui-linkbutton blue`, `hisui-datebox`, `panel-header-gray`, `panel-none-bgcolor`, `top-search-panel`, `bottom-search-panel`, and dialog wrappers such as `dhcdoc-dialog`. The core HISUI stylesheet is `public-mc/css/doctor/public/hui.com.css` plus `hui.pure.css` and `hui.vben.css`.
3. **Per-product CSS trees** — each product (`doc-ws`, `cure-ws`, `dental-ws`, `opadm-mc`, `epmi-mc`, `pilot-project-ws`, `pilot-study-ws`, `triage-ws`) ships its own `css/doctor/<product>/...` directory containing product-scoped overrides and feature-specific stylesheets (e.g. `doc-ws/css/doctor/doc/opdoc/`, `chemo/aform/`, `cure-ws/css/doctor/cure/`).
4. **Shared public styles** — `public-mc/css/doctor/public/` holds cross-product shared CSS: `hui.com.css`, `hui.pure.css`, `hui.vben.css`, `jqgrid.css`, `patinfo.banner.css`, `work.portal.css`, `echarts.css`, `timeSlotSelector.css`, `developUtil.textdicdata.css`, `simplydatagrid.css`, and `custom.setting.css`.
5. **Design tokens via CSS custom properties** — tokenized colors and fonts are declared as CSS variables (e.g. `--default-font-color`, `--body-bgcolor`, `--input-bgcolor`, `--input-border-color`, `--primary-color`, `--text-colon-before-color`, `--text-colon-after-color`, `--text-colon-head-color`, `--datagrid-row-hover-bgcolor`, `--datagrid-row-select-bgcolor`, `--input-placeholder-color`, `--input-hover-bgcolor`) and consumed throughout the codebase via `var(--token, fallback)`.
6. **No modern CSS toolchain** — there is no Tailwind, Sass/Less, PostCSS, or build-time bundler for stylesheets; everything is plain `.css` included directly via `<link>` tags in InterSystems CSP pages.

## Key files and packages

- `src/frontend/public-mc/css/doctor/public/hui.com.css` — global HISUI overrides (panels, dialogs, status badges, buttons, grid cells).
- `src/frontend/public-mc/css/doctor/public/custom.setting.css` — tab panel layout, flex-based form rows, selection cards (`optreat-item`), and label alignment helpers.
- `src/frontend/public-mc/css/doctor/ant/common/color.css` — color token usage via CSS variables.
- `src/frontend/public-mc/css/doctor/ant/common/layout.css` — reusable grid/flex form layouts (`l-form-grid`, `l-form-flex`, `q-container`, `q-form-row`, `q-form-item`).
- `src/frontend/public-mc/css/doctor/ant/config<remote-path>`, `arg.css`, `bsnormal.css` — per-configuration theme variants.
- `src/frontend/{product}/css/doctor/{product}/...` — product-specific style sheets organized by feature area (e.g. `doc-ws/css/doctor/doc/opdoc/`, `doc-ws/css/doctor/doc/oeord/`, `doc-ws/css/doctor/doc/exam/`, `doc-ws/css/doctor/chemo/aform/`, `cure-ws/css/doctor/cure/`, `opadm-mc/css/doctor/opadm/`, `epmi-mc/css/doctor/epmi/`, `pilot-project-ws/css/doctor/pilot/`, `pilot-study-ws/css/doctor/gcpbc/`).
- CSP templates reference these stylesheets via `<link rel="stylesheet" ... href="../css/doctor/public/hui.com.css"/>` and per-page local CSS under `scripts/dhcdoc/css/` or `scripts/dhcdoc/dhcdoccure_hui/css/`.
- `src/frontend/public-mc/scripts_lib/jquery-easyui-1.3.5/themes/default/easyui.css` — base EasyUI theme.
- `src/frontend/public-mc/scripts_lib/mary-panel/marypanel.css` — additional panel component.

## Architecture and conventions

- **CSP-driven composition**: Each page is an InterSystems CSP file that includes the base EasyUI/HISUI CSS once and then appends product- or feature-specific CSS. There is no centralized stylesheet manifest; inclusion is explicit per page.
- **Class naming**: HISUI uses BEM-like prefixes (`hisui-*`, `panel-*`, `tabs-*`, `dialog-*`, `dhcdoc-*`) to scope overrides against EasyUI's global classes. Product-specific styles use flat class names scoped by their directory.
- **Layout primitives**: Reusable layout classes (`l-form-grid`, `l-form-grid2`, `l-form-grid4`, `l-form-grid6`, `q-container`, `q-form-row`, `q-form-item`, `title-right`, `center-block`, `div-v-h-center`, `panel-btns`, `panel-big-btns`) provide consistent spacing and alignment across products.
- **Status/styling patterns**: Grid cell statuses follow two modes — border mode (`.grid-cell-status`) and background mode (`.grid-cell-status-bg`) — with semantic color modifiers (`.red`, `.green`, `.gray`, `.yellow`).
- **Dialog styling**: Dialogs are wrapped in `.dhcdoc-dialog` with transparent backgrounds, removed shadows, and standardized padding/border treatment.
- **Responsive strategy**: No media-query-driven responsive framework is used; responsiveness is achieved through Flexbox/Grid utilities and percentage widths on inputs within the layout primitives. Some product-specific CSS (e.g. `adaptation.css` referenced from `cure-ws`) may contain device-specific rules.
- **Theme tokens**: Colors, backgrounds, borders, and font colors are funneled through CSS custom properties so that different configurations (home, arg, bsnormal) can be swapped by changing variable values rather than rewriting selectors.

## Conventions and constraints

- Styles are **plain CSS only**; no preprocessors or bundlers are configured in this repository.
- All visual tokens should be expressed as **CSS custom properties** (e.g. `var(--default-font-color, #000)`) and overridden at the configuration level, not hard-coded in component styles.
- Global overrides target EasyUI/HISUI classes using `!important` sparingly (mainly for panel backgrounds and radii) to ensure HISUI consistently renders over the default EasyUI theme.
- New product or feature styles should live under `src/frontend/<product>/css/doctor/<product>/...` mirroring the existing directory structure, and be linked from the corresponding CSP page.
- Shared layout and utility classes belong in `public-mc/css/doctor/ant/common/` or `public-mc/css/doctor/public/`; product-specific overrides go under the product's own tree.
- Inline `style="..."` attributes are still present in some legacy CSP pages but the convention is to move presentation into CSS classes whenever possible.
